name: KEEMING
recent: Kee Ming Group Berhad 于2026年11月获得价值 RM44.17 million 的 Puncak Alam 超大规模数据中心分包合约，这是公司第二次赢得此类项目。公司于2026年8月27日召开第一届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收环比增长15.6%，净利环比增长6.1%。
notable: 获得价值 RM44.17 million 的 Puncak Alam 数据中心分包合约。
2026年8月27日召开第一届常年股东大会，所有决议获股东通过。
risks: 独立非执行董事 Ooi Guan Hoe 于2026年9月21日及23日分别出售50,000股普通股。
独立非执行董事 Susie Chung Kim Lan 于2026年9月23日出售50,000股普通股。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为 RM48.4 million，环比增长15.6%；净利为 RM6.447 million，环比增长6.1%；净利率为13.3%，上一季度为14.5%。

recent_en: Kee Ming Group Berhad secured a RM44.17 million hyperscale data centre subcontract in Puncak Alam in November 2026, its second win of such a project. The company held its First Annual General Meeting on 27 August 2026, where all resolutions were passed. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 15.6% QoQ and net profit increased 6.1% QoQ.
notable_en: Secured a RM44.17 million data centre subcontract in Puncak Alam.
Held its First Annual General Meeting on 27 August 2026; all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Ooi Guan Hoe disposed of 50,000 ordinary shares on 21 September 2026 and another 50,000 on 23 September 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Director Susie Chung Kim Lan disposed of 50,000 ordinary shares on 23 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM48.4 million, up 15.6% QoQ; net profit was RM6.447 million, up 6.1% QoQ; net margin was 13.3% versus 14.5% in the previous quarter.
